ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupying the distal portions of both lobes. A central black region extends from the peduncle to the notch. Heavy radial black mottling and dendritic striations transition from the central black area into the distal white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe's vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 15 pixels along the entire trailing boundary; serration intensity increases toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges sweeping to acute distal tips; trailing edges follow a complex concave curve toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, circular white high-contrast pixel groups located on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe near the trailing edge; multiple isolated dark focal spots on the distal white region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of five parallel white linear marks (rake patterns) on the right lobe's dark pigmentation, oriented diagonally toward the notch. One prominent vertical white linear disruption in the center-left black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks on the right lobe medial surface; highly irregular trailing edge topography consistent with acquired micro-trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique feathered pigmentation boundary between the black and white zones on the medial-distal transition of both lobes.
